page.overview:
What is Mary Cattermole?

Mary Elizabeth Cattermole (fl. 1997) was an English Muggle-born witch. She was described as small with dark hair that she wore in a neat bun.

She was the daughter of a Muggle greengrocer and his wife. She married Ministry of Magic employee Reginald Cattermole, with whom she had two daughters, Maisie and Ellie, and one son, Alfred.

In 1997, Mary was falsely accused of stealing the wand of a pure-blood or half-blood witch or wizard, and was brought before a trial by the Muggle-Born Registration Commission. She was trembling as she entered the courtroom, shuddering in the presence of the Dementors. She was interrogated by Dolores Umbridge and Yaxley, who derided her Muggle-born background. Umbridge informed Mary that her wand had been confiscated when she arrived at the Ministry, and wanted to know what wizard or witch she supposedly took the wand from, as Mary was not a real witch in her eyes. She would have been convicted and sent to Azkaban if not for the help of Harry Potter, Hermione Granger (disguised as Albert Runcorn and Mafalda Hopkirk respectively) and Ronald Weasley (disguised as her husband, Reginald) assisting her and a group of Muggle-borns who had been brought in for questioning escape the Ministry. After Harry stunned Umbridge and Yaxley, Umbridge's Persian cat Patronus vanished, and Mary was nearly attacked by the present Dementors before Harry repelled them with his own Patronus. Harry advised Mary and Reg to take their children and flee the country while Voldemort was still in power.

It is unknown if Mary and Reginald managed to escape successfully, or what happened to them and their children after the war. Ron was not hopeful of their escape, as he had the impression that Reginald was not very quick-witted.
